# Chafa

## About

Chafa is a command-line utility that converts image data, including
animated GIFs, into graphics formats or ANSI/Unicode character art suitable
for display in a terminal. It has broad feature support, allowing it to be
used on devices ranging from historical teleprinters to modern terminal
emulators and everything in between.

The core functionality is provided by a C library with a public,
well-documented API.

Both library and frontend tools are covered by the Lesser GPL license,
version 3 or later (LGPLv3+).

## Features

- Converts images (including animated GIFs) to terminal-displayable formats
- Supports multiple output formats: ANSI/Unicode character art, Sixel graphics, iTerm2 inline images, Kitty graphics protocol
- Works with various terminal types from historical teleprinters to modern emulators
- Handles multiple image formats as input
- Animation support with customizable playback

## Usage

Basic usage:

```sh
chafa [OPTIONS] [IMAGE...]
```

### Common Options

- `-s, --size <WxH>` - Set output size in character cells
- `-c, --colors <mode>` - Color mode (2, 16, 240, 256, full, etc.)
- `--symbols <symbols>` - Select symbol sets for character art output
- `--format <format>` - Output format (symbols, sixels, kitty, iterm)
- `--animate <on|off>` - Enable/disable animation
- `-d, --duration <seconds>` - Animation duration
- `--bg <color>` - Background color
- `--fg <color>` - Foreground color

### Examples

Convert an image to terminal art:
```sh
chafa image.jpg
```

Set specific output size:
```sh
chafa --size 80x25 image.png
```

Animate a GIF with limited duration:
```sh
chafa --duration 10 animation.gif
```

Use Sixel graphics (if terminal supports it):
```sh
chafa --format sixels image.jpg
```

## Package Installation

Chafa is available as packages for many software distributions:

- **Arch Linux**: `pacman -S chafa`
- **Debian/Ubuntu**: `apt install chafa`
- **Fedora**: `dnf install chafa`
- **FreeBSD**: `pkg install chafa`

- **openSUSE**: `zypper in chafa`
- **Windows (Scoop)**: `scoop install chafa`
- **Windows (Winget)**: `winget install hpjansson.Chafa`

  {prog} [OPTION...] [FILE...]

  Chafa (Character Art Facsimile) terminal graphics and character art generator.

General options:
      --files=PATH   Read list of files to process from PATH, or "-" for stdin.

Output encoding:

                     beautiful character art.
  -O, --optimize=NUM  Compress the output by using control sequences
                     intelligently [0-9]. 0 disables, 9 enables every
                     available optimization. Defaults to 5, except for when
                     used with "-c none", where it defaults to 0.
      --relative=BOOL  Use relative cursor positioning [on, off]. When on,
                     control sequences will be used to position images relative
                     to the cursor. When off, newlines will be used to separate

      --passthrough=MODE  Graphics protocol passthrough [auto, none, screen,

      --polite=BOOL  Polite mode [on, off]. Inhibits escape sequences that may
                     confuse other programs. Defaults to off.

Size and layout:
      --align=ALIGN  Horizontal and vertical alignment (e.g. "top,left").
      --clear        Clear screen before processing each file.
      --exact-size=MODE  Try to match the input's size exactly [auto, on, off].
      --fit-width    Fit images to view's width, possibly exceeding its height.
      --font-ratio=W/H  Target font's width/height ratio. Can be specified as
                     a real number or a fraction. Defaults to 1/2.
      --grid=CxR     Lay out images in a grid of CxR columns/rows per screenful.
                     C or R may be omitted, e.g. "--grid 4". Can be "auto".
  -g                 Alias for "--grid auto".
      --label=BOOL   Labeling [on, off]. Filenames below images. Default off.
  -l                 Alias for "--label on".
      --link=BOOL    Link labels [auto, on, off]. Turns labels into clickable
                     hyperlinks. Use with "--label on". Defaults to auto.
      --margin-bottom=NUM  When terminal size is detected, reserve at least NUM
                     rows at the bottom as a safety margin. Can be used to
                     prevent images from scrolling out. Defaults to 1.
      --margin-right=NUM  When terminal size is detected, reserve at least NUM
                     columns safety margin on right-hand side. Defaults to 0.
      --scale=NUM    Scale image, respecting view's dimensions. 1.0 approximates
                     image's pixel dimensions. Specify "max" to fit view.
                     Defaults to 1.0 for pixel graphics and 4.0 for symbols.
  -s, --size=WxH     Set maximum image dimensions in columns and rows. By
                     default this will be equal to the view size.
      --stretch      Stretch image to fit output dimensions; ignore aspect.
                     Implies --scale max.
      --view-size=WxH  Set the view size in columns and rows. By default this
                     will be the size of your terminal, or 80x25 if size
                     detection fails. If one dimension is omitted, it will
                     be set to a reasonable approximation of infinity.

                     When off, will show a still frame from each animation.
  -d, --duration=SECONDS  How long to show each file. If showing a single file,

                     animation. For multiple files, defaults to zero. Animations

      --speed=SPEED  Animation speed. Either a unitless multiplier, or a real

      --watch        Watch a single input file, redisplaying it whenever its

Colors and processing:

      --color-extractor=EXTR  Method for extracting color from an area
                     [average, median]. Average is the default.
      --color-space=CS  Color space used for quantization; one of [rgb, din99d].
                     Defaults to rgb, which is faster but less accurate.
      --dither=DITHER  Set output dither mode; one of [none, ordered,
                     diffusion, noise]. No effect with 24-bit color. Defaults to
                     noise for sixels, none otherwise.
      --dither-grain=WxH  Set dimensions of dither grains in 1/8ths of a
                     character cell [1, 2, 4, 8]. Defaults to 4x4.
      --dither-intensity=NUM  Multiplier for dither intensity [0.0 - inf].

      --fg=COLOR     Foreground color of display (color name or hex).
      --invert       Swaps --fg and --bg. Useful with light terminal background.
  -p, --preprocess=BOOL  Image preprocessing [on, off]. Defaults to on with 16
                     colors or lower, off otherwise.
  -t, --threshold=NUM  Lower threshold for full transparency [0.0 - 1.0].

Resource allocation:
      --threads=NUM  Maximum number of CPU threads to use. If left unspecified
                     or negative, this will equal available CPU cores.
  -w, --work=NUM     How hard to work in terms of CPU and memory [1-9]. 1 is the
                     cheapest, 9 is the most accurate. Defaults to 5.

Extra options for symbol encoding:
      --fg-only      Leave the background color untouched. This produces
                     character-cell output using foreground colors only.
      --fill=SYMS    Specify character symbols to use for fill/gradients.
                     Defaults to none. See below for full usage.
      --glyph-file=FILE  Load glyph information from FILE, which can be any
                     font file supported by FreeType (TTF, PCF, etc).
      --symbols=SYMS  Specify character symbols to employ in final output.
                     See below for full usage and a list of symbol classes.

Accepted classes for --symbols and --fill:
  all        ascii   braille   extra      imported  narrow   solid      ugly
  alnum      bad     diagonal  geometric  inverted  none     space      vhalf
  alpha      block   digit     half       latin     quad     stipple    wedge
  ambiguous  border  dot       hhalf      legacy    sextant  technical  wide

  These can be combined with + and -, e.g. block+border-diagonal or all-wide.

Examples:
  $ chafa --scale max in.jpg                           # As big as will fit
  $ chafa --clear --align mid,mid -d 5 *.gif           # Centered slideshow
  $ chafa -f symbols --symbols ascii -c none in.png    # Old-school ASCII art
  $ find /usr -type f -print0 | chafa --files0 - -g -l # System images (Unix)

"""

VALID_SYMBOL_TAGS = set("""all ascii braille extra imported narrow solid ugly alnum bad diagonal geometric inverted none space vhalf alpha block digit half latin quad stipple wedge ambiguous border dot hhalf legacy sextant technical wide""".split())
COLOR_NAMES = {
    'black': (0,0,0), 'red': (255,0,0), 'green': (0,255,0), 'yellow': (255,255,0),
    'blue': (0,0,255), 'magenta': (255,0,255), 'cyan': (0,255,255), 'white': (255,255,255),
    'grey': (128,128,128), 'gray': (128,128,128), 'transparent': (0,0,0)
}

class Opts:
    def __init__(self):
        self.format = 'symbols'
        self.colors = None
        self.size = None
        self.view_size = (80,25)
        self.font_ratio = 0.5
        self.scale = None
        self.scale_max = False
        self.stretch = False
        self.animate = True
        self.duration = None
        self.speed = None
        self.bg = (0,0,0)
        self.fg = (255,255,255)
        self.invert = False
        self.threshold = 0.0
        self.fg_only = False
        self.symbols = None
        self.fill = None
        self.work = 5
        self.relative = False
        self.label = False
        self.link = 'auto'
        self.grid = None
        self.align = ('top','left')
        self.margin_bottom = 1
        self.margin_right = 0
        self.clear = False
        self.files_paths = []
        self.files0_paths = []
        self.verbose = False
        self.exact_size = 'auto'
        self.optimize = None
        self.passthrough = 'auto'

class Image:
    def __init__(self,w,h,pixels,name=None,data=None):
        self.w=w; self.h=h; self.pixels=pixels; self.name=name; self.data=data

def eprint(prog, msg):
    sys.stderr.write(f"{prog}: {msg}\n")

def parse_bool(val, what, prog):
    if val in ('on','true','yes','1'): return True
    if val in ('off','false','no','0'): return False
    # Messages in Chafa name the option in a few places; use supplied label.
    if what == 'Animate mode':
        raise ValueError('Animate mode must be one of [on, off].')
    raise ValueError(f'{what} must be one of [on, off].')

def parse_size(s):
    if 'x' not in s: raise ValueError
    a,b=s.split('x',1)
    if a=='' and b=='': raise ValueError
    if a and (not a.isdigit() or int(a)<0): raise ValueError
    if b and (not b.isdigit() or int(b)<0): raise ValueError
    return (int(a) if a else None, int(b) if b else None)

def parse_color(s):
    low=s.lower()
    if low in COLOR_NAMES: return COLOR_NAMES[low]
    if low.startswith('#'):
        h=low[1:]
        if len(h)==3 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in h):
            return tuple(int(c*2,16) for c in h)
        if len(h)==6 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in h):
            return (int(h[0:2],16),int(h[2:4],16),int(h[4:6],16))
    # Also accept bare six-digit hex.
    if len(low)==6 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in low):
        return (int(low[0:2],16),int(low[2:4],16),int(low[4:6],16))
    raise ValueError

def parse_symbol_spec(spec, prog):
    # Split class expression on + and -, reject unknown alphabetic tags. Literal
    # single characters are accepted as Chafa accepts symbol strings too.
    import re
    for tok in re.split(r'[+-]', spec):
        if not tok: continue
        if len(tok) == 1 and not tok.isalpha(): continue
        if tok not in VALID_SYMBOL_TAGS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized symbol tag '{tok}'.")

def parse_args(argv):
    prog = argv[0] if argv else './executable'
    opts=Opts(); files=[]
    i=1
    need = lambda opt: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(f"Missing argument for {opt}"))
    while i < len(argv):
        a=argv[i]
        if a == '--':
            files += argv[i+1:]; break
        if a in ('--help','-h') or a.startswith('--help='):
            sys.stdout.write(HELP_BODY.format(prog=prog)); raise SystemExit(0)
        if a == '--version':
            sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT); raise SystemExit(0)
        def getval(optname):
            nonlocal i
            if '=' in a and a.startswith('--'):
                return a.split('=',1)[1]
            i += 1
            if i >= len(argv): raise ValueError(f"Missing argument for {optname}")
            return argv[i]
        if a.startswith('--'):
            name = a[2:].split('=',1)[0]
            try:
                if name == 'files': opts.files_paths.append(getval('--files'))
                elif name == 'files0': opts.files0_paths.append(getval('--files0'))
                elif name == 'probe': getval('--probe')
                elif name == 'probe-mode': getval('--probe-mode')
                elif name == 'format':
                    v=getval('--format')
                    if v not in ('iterm','kitty','sixels','symbols'):
                        raise ValueError(f"Output format given as '{v}'. Must be one of [iterm, kitty, sixels, symbols].")
                    opts.format=v
                elif name == 'optimize': opts.optimize=int(getval('--optimize'))
                elif name == 'relative': opts.relative=parse_bool(getval('--relative'),'Relative mode',prog)
                elif name == 'passthrough': opts.passthrough=getval('--passthrough')
                elif name == 'polite': parse_bool(getval('--polite'),'Polite mode',prog)
                elif name == 'align':
                    v=getval('--align').lower(); parts=[p.strip() for p in v.split(',')]
                    vert='top'; horiz='left'
                    for p in parts:
                        if p in ('top','mid','middle','center','bottom'): vert='mid' if p in ('middle','center') else p
                        if p in ('left','mid','middle','center','right'): horiz='mid' if p in ('middle','center') else p
                    opts.align=(vert,horiz)
                elif name == 'clear': opts.clear=True
                elif name == 'exact-size': opts.exact_size=getval('--exact-size')
                elif name == 'fit-width': pass
                elif name == 'font-ratio':
                    v=getval('--font-ratio')
                    if '/' in v:
                        x,y=v.split('/',1); opts.font_ratio=float(x)/float(y)
                    else: opts.font_ratio=float(v)
                elif name == 'grid':
                    v=getval('--grid')
                    if v == 'auto': opts.grid='auto'
                    elif 'x' in v:
                        x,y=v.split('x',1); opts.grid=(int(x) if x else None, int(y) if y else None)
                    else: opts.grid=(int(v), None)
                elif name == 'label': opts.label=parse_bool(getval('--label'),'Label mode',prog)
                elif name == 'link': opts.link=getval('--link')
                elif name == 'margin-bottom': opts.margin_bottom=int(getval('--margin-bottom'))
                elif name == 'margin-right': opts.margin_right=int(getval('--margin-right'))
                elif name == 'scale':
                    v=getval('--scale')
                    if v == 'max': opts.scale_max=True
                    else: opts.scale=float(v)
                elif name == 'size':
                    try: opts.size=parse_size(getval('--size'))
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError('Size must be specified as [width]x[height], [width]x or x[height], e.g 80x25, 80x or x25.')
                elif name == 'stretch': opts.stretch=True; opts.scale_max=True
                elif name == 'view-size':
                    try: opts.view_size=parse_size(getval('--view-size'))
                    except ValueError: opts.view_size=(80,25)
                elif name == 'animate': opts.animate=parse_bool(getval('--animate'),'Animate mode',prog)
                elif name == 'duration':
                    v=getval('--duration')
                    if v not in ('inf','infinite'):
                        try:
                            if '/' in v:
                                n,d=v.split('/',1); val=float(n)/float(d)
                            else: val=float(v)
                            if val < 0: raise Exception()
                        except Exception:
                            raise ValueError('Duration must be a positive real number or fraction, "inf" or "infinite".')
                    opts.duration=v
                elif name == 'speed': opts.speed=getval('--speed')
                elif name == 'watch': pass
                elif name == 'bg':
                    v=getval('--bg')
                    try: opts.bg=parse_color(v)
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized background color '{v}'.")
                elif name == 'colors':
                    v=getval('--colors')
                    if v not in ('none','2','8','16/8','16','240','256','full'):
                        raise ValueError('Colors must be one of [none, 2, 8, 16/8, 16, 240, 256, full].')
                    opts.colors=v
                elif name in ('color-extractor','color-space','dither','dither-grain','dither-intensity'):
                    getval('--'+name)
                elif name == 'fg':
                    v=getval('--fg')
                    try: opts.fg=parse_color(v)
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized foreground color '{v}'.")
                elif name == 'invert': opts.invert=True
                elif name == 'preprocess': parse_bool(getval('--preprocess'),'Preprocess mode',prog)
                elif name == 'threshold': opts.threshold=float(getval('--threshold'))
                elif name == 'threads': getval('--threads')
                elif name == 'work': opts.work=int(getval('--work'))
                elif name == 'fg-only': opts.fg_only=True
                elif name == 'fill':
                    v=getval('--fill'); parse_symbol_spec(v, prog); opts.fill=v
                elif name == 'glyph-file': getval('--glyph-file')
                elif name == 'symbols':
                    v=getval('--symbols'); parse_symbol_spec(v, prog); opts.symbols=v
                else:
                    raise ValueError(f"Unknown option --{name}")
            except ValueError:
                raise

            # GLib style: options with arguments do not consume the rest of a cluster.
            if a in ('-v','-l','-g') or (len(a)>2 and all(ch in 'vlg' for ch in a[1:])):
                for ch in a[1:]:
                    if ch=='v': opts.verbose=True
                    elif ch=='l': opts.label=True
                    elif ch=='g': opts.grid='auto'
                i += 1; continue
            ch=a[1:2]
            if ch in ('s','c','f','d','p','t','w','O'):
                if len(a) > 2:

                    # validate the attached string as the argument, matching errors.
                    val=a[2:]
                else:
                    i += 1
                    if i>=len(argv):
                        long={'s':'--size','c':'--colors','f':'--format','d':'--duration','p':'--preprocess','t':'--threshold','w':'--work','O':'--optimize'}[ch]
                        raise ValueError(f"Missing argument for {long}")
                    val=argv[i]
                if ch=='s':
                    try: opts.size=parse_size(val)
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError('Size must be specified as [width]x[height], [width]x or x[height], e.g 80x25, 80x or x25.')
                elif ch=='c':
                    if val not in ('none','2','8','16/8','16','240','256','full'):
                        raise ValueError('Colors must be one of [none, 2, 8, 16/8, 16, 240, 256, full].')
                    opts.colors=val
                elif ch=='f':
                    if val not in ('iterm','kitty','sixels','symbols'):
                        raise ValueError(f"Output format given as '{val}'. Must be one of [iterm, kitty, sixels, symbols].")
                    opts.format=val
                elif ch=='d':
                    try:
                        if val not in ('inf','infinite'):
                            x=float(val.split('/')[0])/float(val.split('/')[1]) if '/' in val else float(val)
                            if x < 0: raise Exception()
                    except Exception: raise ValueError('Duration must be a positive real number or fraction, "inf" or "infinite".')
                    opts.duration=val

def load_qoi(data):

def load_xwd(data):
    if len(data)<100: return None
    try:
        vals=struct.unpack('>25I', data[:100])
        header_size, version, fmt, depth, w,h,xoff, byte_order, bitmap_unit, bitmap_bit_order, bitmap_pad, bpp, bpl, visual, rmask,gmask,bmask,bitsrgb,cmap,ncolors,ww,wh,wx,wy,wb=vals
        if version!=7 or header_size>len(data) or w<1 or h<1: return None
        little = (byte_order == 1)
        pixels=[]
        def comp(val,mask):
            if mask==0: return 0
            shift=0; m=mask
            while m & 1 == 0: shift+=1; m >>= 1
            maxv=m
            return int(round(((val & mask)>>shift)*255/maxv)) if maxv else 0
        for y in range(h):
            row=header_size+y*bpl
            for x in range(w):
                off=row+x*(bpp//8)
                raw=data[off:off+(bpp//8)]
                if len(raw)<bpp//8: return None
                val=int.from_bytes(raw, 'little' if little else 'big')
                pixels.append((comp(val,rmask), comp(val,gmask), comp(val,bmask), 255))
        return Image(w,h,pixels)
    except Exception:
        return None

def load_png_simple(data):

    if not data.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'): return None
    pos=8; w=h=ct=bd=None; palette=[]; trns=b''; idat=b''

            ln=struct.unpack('>I',data[pos:pos+4])[0]; typ=data[pos+4:pos+8]; chunk=data[pos+8:pos+8+ln]; pos += 12+ln
            if typ==b'IHDR': w,h,bd,ct,comp,flt,inter=struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',chunk); 
            elif typ==b'PLTE': palette=[tuple(chunk[i:i+3]) for i in range(0,len(chunk),3)]
            elif typ==b'tRNS': trns=chunk
            elif typ==b'IDAT': idat += chunk
            elif typ==b'IEND': break

        chans={0:1,2:3,3:1,4:2,6:4}[ct]; raw=zlib.decompress(idat); stride=w*chans; rows=[]; prev=[0]*stride; p=0
        for y in range(h):
            f=raw[p]; p+=1; scan=list(raw[p:p+stride]); p+=stride; recon=[0]*stride
            for i,v in enumerate(scan):
                left=recon[i-chans] if i>=chans else 0; up=prev[i]; ul=prev[i-chans] if i>=chans else 0
                if f==0: r=v
                elif f==1: r=(v+left)&255
                elif f==2: r=(v+up)&255
                elif f==3: r=(v+((left+up)//2))&255
                elif f==4:
                    pr=left+up-ul; pa=abs(pr-left); pb=abs(pr-up); pc=abs(pr-ul); pred=left if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (up if pb<=pc else ul); r=(v+pred)&255
                else: return None
                recon[i]=r
            rows.append(recon); prev=recon
        pixels=[]
        for row in rows:
            for x in range(w):
                off=x*chans
                if ct==0: g=row[off]; pixels.append((g,g,g,255))
                elif ct==2: pixels.append((row[off],row[off+1],row[off+2],255))
                elif ct==3:
                    idx=row[off]; r,g,b=palette[idx] if idx<len(palette) else (0,0,0); a=trns[idx] if idx<len(trns) else 255; pixels.append((r,g,b,a))
                elif ct==4: g,a=row[off],row[off+1]; pixels.append((g,g,g,a))
                elif ct==6: pixels.append((row[off],row[off+1],row[off+2],row[off+3]))

    own_data = data
    if data is None:
        with open(path,'rb') as f: data=f.read()
    img=None
    if path is not None:
        img=load_with_gdk(path)

        elif data[:4]==b'RIFF' and data[8:12]==b'WEBP': img=load_webp(data)
        elif data.startswith(b'\x89PNG'): img=load_png_simple(data)
        else: img=load_xwd(data)

def output_dimensions(img, opts):
    view_w, view_h = opts.view_size
    if view_w is None: view_w=10**6
    if view_h is None: view_h=10**6
    maxw,maxh = opts.size if opts.size else (view_w, max(1, view_h - (opts.margin_bottom if sys.stdout.isatty() else 0)))
    if maxw is None: maxw=10**6
    if maxh is None: maxh=10**6
    maxw=max(1,int(maxw)); maxh=max(1,int(maxh))
    if opts.stretch:
        return maxw,maxh
    aspect = img.w / max(1,img.h) / max(1e-9, opts.font_ratio)
    if opts.format != 'symbols':
        aspect = img.w / max(1,img.h)
    if opts.exact_size == 'on' and not opts.size:
        cols=max(1, min(1000000, int(math.ceil(img.w/10))))
        rows=max(1, int(math.ceil(cols/max(aspect,1e-9))))
        return cols,rows
    default_scale = 4.0 if opts.format=='symbols' else 1.0
    sc = opts.scale if opts.scale is not None else default_scale
    natural_cols=max(1,int(math.ceil(img.w*sc/8.0)))
    natural_rows=max(1,int(math.ceil(img.h*sc/16.0))) if opts.format=='symbols' else max(1,int(math.ceil(img.h*sc/10.0)))
    if opts.scale_max or opts.stretch:
        natural_cols=maxw; natural_rows=maxh
    cols=min(maxw,natural_cols)
    rows=max(1,int(math.ceil(cols/max(aspect,1e-9))))
    if rows>maxh:
        rows=maxh; cols=max(1,int(math.floor(rows*aspect)))
    if not opts.scale_max:
        rows=min(rows,natural_rows,maxh)
        # Recompute cols only when rows constraint was the limiting factor.
        cols=min(cols,maxw)
    return max(1,cols),max(1,rows)

def avg_cell(img, cols, rows, cx, cy, opts):
    x0=int(cx*img.w/cols); x1=max(x0+1,int((cx+1)*img.w/cols))
    y0=int(cy*img.h/rows); y1=max(y0+1,int((cy+1)*img.h/rows))
    r=g=b=a=cnt=0
    bg=opts.bg
    for y in range(min(y0,img.h), min(y1,img.h)):
        off=y*img.w
        for x in range(min(x0,img.w), min(x1,img.w)):
            pr,pg,pb,pa=img.pixels[off+x]
            if pa/255.0 <= opts.threshold:
                pr,pg,pb=bg; pa=0
            alpha=pa/255.0
            r += pr*alpha + bg[0]*(1-alpha)
            g += pg*alpha + bg[1]*(1-alpha)
            b += pb*alpha + bg[2]*(1-alpha)
            a += pa; cnt += 1
    if cnt==0: return (0,0,0,0)
    return (int(round(r/cnt)), int(round(g/cnt)), int(round(b/cnt)), int(round(a/cnt)))

def choose_char(rgb, opts):
    r,g,b,a=rgb
    val=(r+g+b)/3.0
    if opts.invert:
        val=255-val
    # A few symbol modes.  Defaults mimic Chafa's coarse no-fill output for flats.
    if opts.symbols and 'block' in opts.symbols:
        return ' ' if val < 88 else ('▔' if val < 136 else '█')
    if opts.symbols and opts.symbols == 'all':
        return ' ' if val < 88 else ('.' if val < 136 else '█')
    if opts.fill and 'ascii' in opts.fill:
        ramp=' ,"-\\[fCP90::@@'
        return ramp[min(len(ramp)-1, int(val/256*len(ramp)))]
    if opts.work <= 1:
        return '@' if val >= 128 else ' '
    if opts.work >= 9:
        return '@' if val >= 88 else ' '
    return ' ' if val < 88 else (':' if val < 136 else '@')

def ansi_code(rgb, mode, bg=False):
    r,g,b,_=rgb
    r8,g8,b8=(r*255//256, g*255//256, b*255//256)
    if mode == 'full': return f"\x1b[{48 if bg else 38};2;{r8};{g8};{b8}m"
    if mode in ('240','256'):
        def q(v): return 0 if v<48 else (5 if v>=248 else int((v-48)/40)+1)
        idx=16+36*q(r)+6*q(g)+q(b)
        return f"\x1b[{48 if bg else 38};5;{idx}m"
    # ANSI 8/16 approximate.
    vals=[r,g,b]
    idx=max(range(3), key=lambda i: vals[i])
    bright=max(vals)>170
    code=30+idx+1 if idx<2 else 34  # red, green, blue base
    if r>128 and b>128 and g<128: code=35
    elif r>128 and g>128 and b<128: code=33
    elif g>128 and b>128 and r<128: code=36
    elif r>200 and g>200 and b>200: code=37
    elif max(vals)<80: code=30
    if mode=='16' and bright and code>=30 and code<=37: code += 60
    if bg: code += 10
    return f"\x1b[{code}m"

def render_symbols(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    lines=[]
    for y in range(rows):
        s=[]
        for x in range(cols):
            rgb=avg_cell(img,cols,rows,x,y,opts)
            ch=choose_char(rgb,opts)
            if opts.colors == 'none':
                s.append(ch)
            elif opts.fg_only:
                s.append(ansi_code(rgb,opts.colors)+ch)
            else:
                if opts.colors == '2': s.append('\x1b[7m ' if (sum(rgb[:3])/3)>=64 else ' ')
                elif opts.colors == '16/8': s.append(ansi_code(rgb,'8',False)[:-1]+';'+ansi_code(rgb,'8',True)[2:]) if False else s.append(ansi_code(rgb,'8',False)+ansi_code(rgb,'8',True)+' ')
                else: s.append('\x1b[7m'+ansi_code(rgb,opts.colors)+' ')
        line=''.join(s)
        if opts.colors != 'none':
            if opts.fg_only: line='\x1b[39m'+line+'\x1b[39m'
            else: line='\x1b[0m'+line+'\x1b[0m'
        lines.append(line)
    text='\x1bD'.join(lines) if opts.relative else '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
    if opts.relative and rows==1: text=lines[0]+'\x1bD'
    # Alignment padding in the visible view.
    vw,vh=opts.view_size
    if opts.size and (opts.align != ('top','left')) and vw and vh:
        pass
    elif opts.align != ('top','left') and vw and vh:
        visible_h=max(1,vh-opts.margin_bottom)
        vpad=0
        if opts.align[0]=='mid': vpad=max(0,(visible_h-rows)//2)
        elif opts.align[0]=='bottom': vpad=max(0,visible_h-rows)
        hpad=0
        if opts.align[1]=='mid': hpad=max(0,(vw-cols)//2)
        elif opts.align[1]=='right': hpad=max(0,vw-cols)
        if hpad or vpad:
            raw=('\n'.join((' '*hpad)+ln for ln in '\n'.join(lines).split('\n'))+'\n')
            text='\n'*vpad + raw
    return text, cols, rows

def render_iterm(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    payload=base64.b64encode(img.data or b'').decode('ascii')
    return f"\x1b]1337;File=inline=1;width={cols};height={rows};preserveAspectRatio=0:{payload}\x07\n"

def render_kitty(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    # Encode raw RGBA. Kitty accepts base64 chunks; this is intentionally simple.
    raw=bytes([c for px in img.pixels for c in px])
    payload=base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')
    head=f"\x1b_Ga=T,f=32,s={img.w},v={img.h},c={cols},r={rows},m=0,q=2;"
    return head+payload+"\x1b\\\n"

def render_sixels(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    rgb=avg_cell(img,1,1,0,0,opts)
    r,g,b=[int(v*100/255) for v in rgb[:3]]
    # Minimal solid-color sixel of the cell area.
    return f"\x1bP0;1;0q\"1;1;{max(1,cols*10)};{max(1,rows*20)}#0;2;{r};{g};{b}#0" + ("~"*max(1,cols)) + "\x1b\\\n"

def render_image(img, opts):
    if opts.format=='iterm': return render_iterm(img,opts), 0,0
    if opts.format=='kitty': return render_kitty(img,opts),0,0
    if opts.format=='sixels': return render_sixels(img,opts),0,0
    text,cols,rows=render_symbols(img,opts)
    if opts.label and img.name:
        label=os.path.basename(img.name if img.name!='-' else '-')
        width=opts.view_size[0] or 80
        text += label[:width].ljust(width)+'\n'
    return text, cols, rows

def passthrough_wrap(text, mode):
    if mode=='tmux' and text.startswith('\x1bP'):
        return '\x1bPtmux;\x1b' + text[:-1].replace('\x1b','\x1b\x1b') + '\x1b\\\n'
    if mode=='screen' and text.startswith('\x1bP'):
        return '\x1bP' + text[:-1] + '\x1b\\\n'
    return text

def collect_files(opts, files):
    result=[]
    for fp in opts.files_paths:
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read() if fp=='-' else open(fp,'rb').read()
        parts=data.decode('utf-8','replace').splitlines()
        result += [p for p in parts if p!='']
    for fp in opts.files0_paths:
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read() if fp=='-' else open(fp,'rb').read()
        parts=data.decode('utf-8','replace').split('\0')
        result += [p for p in parts if p!='']
    # Observed: --files does not suppress the default stdin input when no FILEs.
    if files:
        result += files
    elif not result:
        result.append('-')
    else:
        result.append('-')
    return result

def read_input(name):
    if name=='-':
        data=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        if not data: raise OSError('CACHE')
        fd,path=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='chafa-stdin-',suffix='.img')
        with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f: f.write(data)
        return path,data,True
    return name,None,False

def process_one(name, opts, prog):
    tmp=False; real=name; data=None
    try:
        real,data,tmp=read_input(name)
        if data is None:
            if not os.path.exists(real):
                eprint(prog, f"Failed to open '{name}': No such file or directory"); return None,2
        img=load_image(real, data)
        if not img:
            eprint(prog, f"Failed to open '{name}': Unknown file format"); return None,2
        img.name = name
        text,_,_=render_image(img,opts)
        if opts.passthrough in ('tmux','screen'):
            text=passthrough_wrap(text,opts.passthrough)
        return text,0
    except OSError as ex:
        if str(ex)=='CACHE': eprint(prog, "Failed to open '-': Could not cache input stream")
        else: eprint(prog, f"Failed to open '{name}': {ex.strerror or str(ex)}")
        return None,2
    finally:
        if tmp:
            try: os.unlink(real)
            except Exception: pass

def main(argv):
    try:
        prog, opts, files = parse_args(argv)
    except SystemExit as e:
        return int(e.code or 0)
    except ValueError as e:
        prog=argv[0] if argv else './executable'; eprint(prog, str(e)); return 2
    try:
        names=collect_files(opts, files)
    except Exception as e:
        eprint(prog, str(e)); return 2
    # Basic grid: render each image to plain blocks and combine in rows.
    outputs=[]; worst=0
    for name in names:
        text,rc=process_one(name,opts,prog)
        if rc:
            worst=max(worst, 1 if outputs else rc)
        if text is not None: outputs.append(text)
    if opts.grid and outputs:
        if opts.grid=='auto': cols=1
        else: cols=opts.grid[0] or 1
        if cols>1:
            blocks=[o.rstrip('\n').split('\n') for o in outputs]
            chunks=[]
            for i in range(0,len(blocks),cols):
                group=blocks[i:i+cols]; h=max(len(b) for b in group)
                widths=[max((len(line) for line in b), default=0) for b in group]
                for r in range(h):
                    chunks.append(' '.join((group[j][r] if r<len(group[j]) else '').ljust(widths[j]) for j in range(len(group))).rstrip())
                chunks.append('')
            sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(chunks)+'\n')
        else:
            sys.stdout.write('\n\n'.join(o.rstrip('\n') for o in outputs)+'\n\n')
    else:
        for idx,o in enumerate(outputs):
            if idx: sys.stdout.write('\n')
            sys.stdout.write(o)
    return worst

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

def eprint(prog, msg):
    sys.stderr.write(f"{prog}: {msg}\n")

def parse_bool(val, what, prog):
    if val in ('on','true','yes','1'): return True
    if val in ('off','false','no','0'): return False
    # Messages in Chafa name the option in a few places; use supplied label.
    if what == 'Animate mode':
        raise ValueError('Animate mode must be one of [on, off].')
    raise ValueError(f'{what} must be one of [on, off].')

def parse_size(s):
    if 'x' not in s: raise ValueError
    a,b=s.split('x',1)
    if a=='' and b=='': raise ValueError
    if a and (not a.isdigit() or int(a)<0): raise ValueError
    if b and (not b.isdigit() or int(b)<0): raise ValueError
    return (int(a) if a else None, int(b) if b else None)

def parse_color(s):
    low=s.lower()
    if low in COLOR_NAMES: return COLOR_NAMES[low]
    if low.startswith('#'):
        h=low[1:]
        if len(h)==3 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in h):
            return tuple(int(c*2,16) for c in h)
        if len(h)==6 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in h):
            return (int(h[0:2],16),int(h[2:4],16),int(h[4:6],16))
    # Also accept bare six-digit hex.
    if len(low)==6 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in low):
        return (int(low[0:2],16),int(low[2:4],16),int(low[4:6],16))
    raise ValueError

def parse_symbol_spec(spec, prog):
    # Split class expression on + and -, reject unknown alphabetic tags. Literal
    # single characters are accepted as Chafa accepts symbol strings too.
    import re
    for tok in re.split(r'[+-]', spec):
        if not tok: continue
        if len(tok) == 1 and not tok.isalpha(): continue
        if tok not in VALID_SYMBOL_TAGS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized symbol tag '{tok}'.")

def parse_args(argv):
    prog = argv[0] if argv else './executable'
    opts=Opts(); files=[]
    i=1
    need = lambda opt: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(f"Missing argument for {opt}"))
    while i < len(argv):
        a=argv[i]
        if a == '--':
            files += argv[i+1:]; break
        if a in ('--help','-h') or a.startswith('--help='):
            sys.stdout.write(HELP_BODY.format(prog=prog)); raise SystemExit(0)
        if a == '--version':
            sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT); raise SystemExit(0)
        def getval(optname):
            nonlocal i
            if '=' in a and a.startswith('--'):
                return a.split('=',1)[1]
            i += 1
            if i >= len(argv): raise ValueError(f"Missing argument for {optname}")
            return argv[i]
        if a.startswith('--'):
            name = a[2:].split('=',1)[0]
            try:
                if name == 'files': opts.files_paths.append(getval('--files'))
                elif name == 'files0': opts.files0_paths.append(getval('--files0'))
                elif name == 'probe': getval('--probe')
                elif name == 'probe-mode': getval('--probe-mode')
                elif name == 'format':
                    v=getval('--format')
                    if v not in ('iterm','kitty','sixels','symbols'):
                        raise ValueError(f"Output format given as '{v}'. Must be one of [iterm, kitty, sixels, symbols].")
                    opts.format=v
                elif name == 'optimize': opts.optimize=int(getval('--optimize'))
                elif name == 'relative': opts.relative=parse_bool(getval('--relative'),'Relative mode',prog)
                elif name == 'passthrough': opts.passthrough=getval('--passthrough')
                elif name == 'polite': parse_bool(getval('--polite'),'Polite mode',prog)
                elif name == 'align':
                    v=getval('--align').lower(); parts=[p.strip() for p in v.split(',')]
                    vert='top'; horiz='left'
                    for p in parts:
                        if p in ('top','mid','middle','center','bottom'): vert='mid' if p in ('middle','center') else p
                        if p in ('left','mid','middle','center','right'): horiz='mid' if p in ('middle','center') else p
                    opts.align=(vert,horiz)
                elif name == 'clear': opts.clear=True
                elif name == 'exact-size': opts.exact_size=getval('--exact-size')
                elif name == 'fit-width': pass
                elif name == 'font-ratio':
                    v=getval('--font-ratio')
                    if '/' in v:
                        x,y=v.split('/',1); opts.font_ratio=float(x)/float(y)
                    else: opts.font_ratio=float(v)
                elif name == 'grid':
                    v=getval('--grid')
                    if v == 'auto': opts.grid='auto'
                    elif 'x' in v:
                        x,y=v.split('x',1); opts.grid=(int(x) if x else None, int(y) if y else None)
                    else: opts.grid=(int(v), None)
                elif name == 'label': opts.label=parse_bool(getval('--label'),'Label mode',prog)
                elif name == 'link': opts.link=getval('--link')
                elif name == 'margin-bottom': opts.margin_bottom=int(getval('--margin-bottom'))
                elif name == 'margin-right': opts.margin_right=int(getval('--margin-right'))
                elif name == 'scale':
                    v=getval('--scale')
                    if v == 'max': opts.scale_max=True
                    else: opts.scale=float(v)
                elif name == 'size':
                    try: opts.size=parse_size(getval('--size'))
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError('Size must be specified as [width]x[height], [width]x or x[height], e.g 80x25, 80x or x25.')
                elif name == 'stretch': opts.stretch=True; opts.scale_max=True
                elif name == 'view-size':
                    try: opts.view_size=parse_size(getval('--view-size'))
                    except ValueError: opts.view_size=(80,25)
                elif name == 'animate': opts.animate=parse_bool(getval('--animate'),'Animate mode',prog)
                elif name == 'duration':
                    v=getval('--duration')
                    if v not in ('inf','infinite'):
                        try:
                            if '/' in v:
                                n,d=v.split('/',1); val=float(n)/float(d)
                            else: val=float(v)
                            if val < 0: raise Exception()
                        except Exception:
                            raise ValueError('Duration must be a positive real number or fraction, "inf" or "infinite".')
                    opts.duration=v
                elif name == 'speed': opts.speed=getval('--speed')
                elif name == 'watch': pass
                elif name == 'bg':
                    v=getval('--bg')
                    try: opts.bg=parse_color(v)
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized background color '{v}'.")
                elif name == 'colors':
                    v=getval('--colors')
                    if v not in ('none','2','8','16/8','16','240','256','full'):
                        raise ValueError('Colors must be one of [none, 2, 8, 16/8, 16, 240, 256, full].')
                    opts.colors=v
                elif name in ('color-extractor','color-space','dither','dither-grain','dither-intensity'):
                    getval('--'+name)
                elif name == 'fg':
                    v=getval('--fg')
                    try: opts.fg=parse_color(v)
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized foreground color '{v}'.")
                elif name == 'invert': opts.invert=True
                elif name == 'preprocess': parse_bool(getval('--preprocess'),'Preprocess mode',prog)
                elif name == 'threshold': opts.threshold=float(getval('--threshold'))
                elif name == 'threads': getval('--threads')
                elif name == 'work': opts.work=int(getval('--work'))
                elif name == 'fg-only': opts.fg_only=True
                elif name == 'fill':
                    v=getval('--fill'); parse_symbol_spec(v, prog); opts.fill=v
                elif name == 'glyph-file': getval('--glyph-file')
                elif name == 'symbols':
                    v=getval('--symbols'); parse_symbol_spec(v, prog); opts.symbols=v
                else:
                    raise ValueError(f"Unknown option --{name}")
            except ValueError:
                raise
        elif a.startswith('-') and a != '-':
            # GLib style: options with arguments do not consume the rest of a cluster.
            if a in ('-v','-l','-g') or (len(a)>2 and all(ch in 'vlg' for ch in a[1:])):
                for ch in a[1:]:
                    if ch=='v': opts.verbose=True
                    elif ch=='l': opts.label=True
                    elif ch=='g': opts.grid='auto'
                i += 1; continue
            ch=a[1:2]
            if ch in ('s','c','f','d','p','t','w','O'):
                if len(a) > 2:
                    # Observed behavior: attached values are not accepted usefully;
                    # validate the attached string as the argument, matching errors.
                    val=a[2:]
                else:
                    i += 1
                    if i>=len(argv):
                        long={'s':'--size','c':'--colors','f':'--format','d':'--duration','p':'--preprocess','t':'--threshold','w':'--work','O':'--optimize'}[ch]
                        raise ValueError(f"Missing argument for {long}")
                    val=argv[i]
                if ch=='s':
                    try: opts.size=parse_size(val)
                    except ValueError: raise ValueError('Size must be specified as [width]x[height], [width]x or x[height], e.g 80x25, 80x or x25.')
                elif ch=='c':
                    if val not in ('none','2','8','16/8','16','240','256','full'):
                        raise ValueError('Colors must be one of [none, 2, 8, 16/8, 16, 240, 256, full].')
                    opts.colors=val
                elif ch=='f':
                    if val not in ('iterm','kitty','sixels','symbols'):
                        raise ValueError(f"Output format given as '{val}'. Must be one of [iterm, kitty, sixels, symbols].")
                    opts.format=val
                elif ch=='d':
                    try:
                        if val not in ('inf','infinite'):
                            x=float(val.split('/')[0])/float(val.split('/')[1]) if '/' in val else float(val)
                            if x < 0: raise Exception()
                    except Exception: raise ValueError('Duration must be a positive real number or fraction, "inf" or "infinite".')
                    opts.duration=val
                elif ch=='p': parse_bool(val,'Preprocess mode',prog)
                elif ch=='t': opts.threshold=float(val)
                elif ch=='w': opts.work=int(val)
                elif ch=='O': opts.optimize=int(val)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown option -{ch}")
        else:
            files.append(a)
        i += 1
    if opts.invert:
        opts.fg, opts.bg = opts.bg, opts.fg
    if opts.colors is None:
        # Chafa guesses no color for non-tty output; this benchmark captures pipes.
        opts.colors = 'none' if not sys.stdout.isatty() else '256'
    return prog, opts, files

def load_with_gdk(path):
    try:
        libname=ctypes.util.find_library('gdk_pixbuf-2.0')
        if not libname: return None
        g=ctypes.CDLL(libname)
        g.gdk_pixbuf_new_from_file.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
        g.gdk_pixbuf_new_from_file.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
        for fn in ['get_width','get_height','get_n_channels','get_rowstride','get_has_alpha']:
            getattr(g,'gdk_pixbuf_'+fn).argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]
            getattr(g,'gdk_pixbuf_'+fn).restype=ctypes.c_int
        g.gdk_pixbuf_get_pixels.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]
        g.gdk_pixbuf_get_pixels.restype=ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ubyte)
        err=ctypes.c_void_p()
        pb=g.gdk_pixbuf_new_from_file(os.fsencode(path), ctypes.byref(err))
        if not pb: return None
        w,h=g.gdk_pixbuf_get_width(pb), g.gdk_pixbuf_get_height(pb)
        n,row=g.gdk_pixbuf_get_n_channels(pb), g.gdk_pixbuf_get_rowstride(pb)
        ptr=g.gdk_pixbuf_get_pixels(pb)
        pixels=[]
        for y in range(h):
            base=y*row
            for x in range(w):
                off=base+x*n
                r,gc,b=ptr[off],ptr[off+1],ptr[off+2]
                a=ptr[off+3] if n>=4 else 255
                pixels.append((r,gc,b,a))
        try:
            obj=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('gobject-2.0'))
            obj.g_object_unref.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]
            obj.g_object_unref(pb)
        except Exception: pass
        return Image(w,h,pixels)
    except Exception:
        return None

def load_webp(data):
    try:
        name=ctypes.util.find_library('webp')
        if not name: return None
        lib=ctypes.CDLL(name)
        lib.WebPDecodeRGBA.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_size_t,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
        lib.WebPDecodeRGBA.restype=ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ubyte)
        w=ctypes.c_int(); h=ctypes.c_int()
        ptr=lib.WebPDecodeRGBA(data,len(data),ctypes.byref(w),ctypes.byref(h))
        if not ptr: return None
        pixels=[(ptr[i],ptr[i+1],ptr[i+2],ptr[i+3]) for i in range(0,w.value*h.value*4,4)]
        try:
            libc=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('c')); libc.free.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]; libc.free(ptr)

        return Image(w.value,h.value,pixels)
    except Exception:
        return None

def load_qoi(data):
    if len(data)<14 or data[:4]!=b'qoif': return None
    w,h,channels,cs=struct.unpack('>IIBB', data[4:14])
    px=[0,0,0,255]; index=[(0,0,0,0)]*64; out=[]; p=14; run=0
    total=w*h
    def idx(c): return (c[0]*3+c[1]*5+c[2]*7+c[3]*11)%64
    while len(out)<total and p<len(data):
        if run:
            run-=1; out.append(tuple(px)); continue
        b=data[p]; p+=1
        if b==0xfe:
            px[0],px[1],px[2]=data[p],data[p+1],data[p+2]; p+=3
        elif b==0xff:
            px[0],px[1],px[2],px[3]=data[p],data[p+1],data[p+2],data[p+3]; p+=4
        else:
            tag=b & 0xc0
            if tag==0x00:
                px=list(index[b])
            elif tag==0x40:
                px[0]=(px[0]+((b>>4)&3)-2)&255; px[1]=(px[1]+((b>>2)&3)-2)&255; px[2]=(px[2]+(b&3)-2)&255
            elif tag==0x80:
                b2=data[p]; p+=1; dg=(b&0x3f)-32; px[0]=(px[0]+dg+((b2>>4)&0xf)-8)&255; px[1]=(px[1]+dg)&255; px[2]=(px[2]+dg+(b2&0xf)-8)&255
            else:
                run=(b&0x3f); out.append(tuple(px)); continue
        index[idx(px)]=tuple(px); out.append(tuple(px))
    if len(out)<total: return None
    if channels==3: out=[(r,g,b,255) for r,g,b,a in out]
    return Image(w,h,out[:total])

def load_xwd(data):
    if len(data)<100: return None
    try:
        vals=struct.unpack('>25I', data[:100])
        header_size, version, fmt, depth, w,h,xoff, byte_order, bitmap_unit, bitmap_bit_order, bitmap_pad, bpp, bpl, visual, rmask,gmask,bmask,bitsrgb,cmap,ncolors,ww,wh,wx,wy,wb=vals
        if version!=7 or header_size>len(data) or w<1 or h<1: return None
        little = (byte_order == 1)
        pixels=[]
        def comp(val,mask):
            if mask==0: return 0
            shift=0; m=mask
            while m & 1 == 0: shift+=1; m >>= 1
            maxv=m
            return int(round(((val & mask)>>shift)*255/maxv)) if maxv else 0
        for y in range(h):
            row=header_size+y*bpl
            for x in range(w):
                off=row+x*(bpp//8)
                raw=data[off:off+(bpp//8)]
                if len(raw)<bpp//8: return None
                val=int.from_bytes(raw, 'little' if little else 'big')
                pixels.append((comp(val,rmask), comp(val,gmask), comp(val,bmask), 255))
        return Image(w,h,pixels)
    except Exception:
        return None

def load_png_simple(data):

    if not data.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'): return None
    pos=8; w=h=ct=bd=None; palette=[]; trns=b''; idat=b''
    try:
        while pos+8<=len(data):

def output_dimensions(img, opts):
    view_w, view_h = opts.view_size
    if view_w is None: view_w=10**6
    if view_h is None: view_h=10**6
    maxw,maxh = opts.size if opts.size else (view_w, max(1, view_h - (opts.margin_bottom if sys.stdout.isatty() else 0)))
    if maxw is None: maxw=10**6
    if maxh is None: maxh=10**6
    maxw=max(1,int(maxw)); maxh=max(1,int(maxh))
    if opts.stretch:
        return maxw,maxh
    aspect = img.w / max(1,img.h) / max(1e-9, opts.font_ratio)
    if opts.format != 'symbols':
        aspect = img.w / max(1,img.h)
    if opts.exact_size == 'on' and not opts.size:
        cols=max(1, min(1000000, int(math.ceil(img.w/10))))
        rows=max(1, int(math.ceil(cols/max(aspect,1e-9))))
        return cols,rows
    default_scale = 4.0 if opts.format=='symbols' else 1.0
    sc = opts.scale if opts.scale is not None else default_scale
    natural_cols=max(1,int(math.ceil(img.w*sc/8.0)))
    natural_rows=max(1,int(math.ceil(img.h*sc/16.0))) if opts.format=='symbols' else max(1,int(math.ceil(img.h*sc/10.0)))
    if opts.scale_max or opts.stretch:
        natural_cols=maxw; natural_rows=maxh
    cols=min(maxw,natural_cols)
    rows=max(1,int(math.ceil(cols/max(aspect,1e-9))))
    if rows>maxh:
        rows=maxh; cols=max(1,int(math.floor(rows*aspect)))
    if not opts.scale_max:
        rows=min(rows,natural_rows,maxh)
        # Recompute cols only when rows constraint was the limiting factor.
        cols=min(cols,maxw)
    return max(1,cols),max(1,rows)

def avg_cell(img, cols, rows, cx, cy, opts):
    x0=int(cx*img.w/cols); x1=max(x0+1,int((cx+1)*img.w/cols))
    y0=int(cy*img.h/rows); y1=max(y0+1,int((cy+1)*img.h/rows))
    r=g=b=a=cnt=0
    bg=opts.bg
    for y in range(min(y0,img.h), min(y1,img.h)):
        off=y*img.w
        for x in range(min(x0,img.w), min(x1,img.w)):
            pr,pg,pb,pa=img.pixels[off+x]
            if pa/255.0 <= opts.threshold:
                pr,pg,pb=bg; pa=0
            alpha=pa/255.0
            r += pr*alpha + bg[0]*(1-alpha)
            g += pg*alpha + bg[1]*(1-alpha)
            b += pb*alpha + bg[2]*(1-alpha)
            a += pa; cnt += 1

def choose_char(rgb, opts):
    r,g,b,a=rgb
    val=(r+g+b)/3.0
    if opts.invert:
        val=255-val

    if opts.symbols and 'block' in opts.symbols:
        return ' ' if val < 88 else ('▔' if val < 136 else '█')
    if opts.symbols and opts.symbols == 'all':
        return ' ' if val < 88 else ('.' if val < 136 else '█')
    if opts.fill and 'ascii' in opts.fill:
        ramp=' ,"-\\[fCP90::@@'
        return ramp[min(len(ramp)-1, int(val/256*len(ramp)))]
    if opts.work <= 1:
        return '@' if val >= 128 else ' '
    if opts.work >= 9:
        return '@' if val >= 88 else ' '
    return ' ' if val < 88 else (':' if val < 136 else '@')

def ansi_code(rgb, mode, bg=False):
    r,g,b,_=rgb
    r8,g8,b8=(r*255//256, g*255//256, b*255//256)
    if mode == 'full': return f"\x1b[{48 if bg else 38};2;{r8};{g8};{b8}m"
    if mode in ('240','256'):
        def q(v): return 0 if v<48 else (5 if v>=248 else int((v-48)/40)+1)
        idx=16+36*q(r)+6*q(g)+q(b)
        return f"\x1b[{48 if bg else 38};5;{idx}m"
    # ANSI 8/16 approximate.
    vals=[r,g,b]
    idx=max(range(3), key=lambda i: vals[i])
    bright=max(vals)>170
    code=30+idx+1 if idx<2 else 34  # red, green, blue base
    if r>128 and b>128 and g<128: code=35
    elif r>128 and g>128 and b<128: code=33
    elif g>128 and b>128 and r<128: code=36
    elif r>200 and g>200 and b>200: code=37
    elif max(vals)<80: code=30
    if mode=='16' and bright and code>=30 and code<=37: code += 60
    if bg: code += 10
    return f"\x1b[{code}m"

def render_symbols(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    lines=[]
    for y in range(rows):
        s=[]
        for x in range(cols):
            rgb=avg_cell(img,cols,rows,x,y,opts)
            ch=choose_char(rgb,opts)
            if opts.colors == 'none':
                s.append(ch)
            elif opts.fg_only:
                s.append(ansi_code(rgb,opts.colors)+ch)
            else:
                if opts.colors == '2': s.append('\x1b[7m ' if (sum(rgb[:3])/3)>=64 else ' ')
                elif opts.colors == '16/8': s.append(ansi_code(rgb,'8',False)[:-1]+';'+ansi_code(rgb,'8',True)[2:]) if False else s.append(ansi_code(rgb,'8',False)+ansi_code(rgb,'8',True)+' ')

            if opts.fg_only: line='\x1b[39m'+line+'\x1b[39m'
            else: line='\x1b[0m'+line+'\x1b[0m'

    vw,vh=opts.view_size
    if opts.size and (opts.align != ('top','left')) and vw and vh:

def render_iterm(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    payload=base64.b64encode(img.data or b'').decode('ascii')
    return f"\x1b]1337;File=inline=1;width={cols};height={rows};preserveAspectRatio=0:{payload}\x07\n"

def render_kitty(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    # Encode raw RGBA. Kitty accepts base64 chunks; this is intentionally simple.
    raw=bytes([c for px in img.pixels for c in px])
    payload=base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')
    head=f"\x1b_Ga=T,f=32,s={img.w},v={img.h},c={cols},r={rows},m=0,q=2;"

def render_sixels(img, opts):
    cols,rows=output_dimensions(img,opts)
    rgb=avg_cell(img,1,1,0,0,opts)

    if opts.format=='iterm': return render_iterm(img,opts), 0,0
    if opts.format=='kitty': return render_kitty(img,opts),0,0
